map.起征点可调整以适配不同政策口径: The threshold is adjustable to fit different policy scopes

map.速算扣除数须与所属税率档配套使用，跨档时切不可混用: The quick deduction must be used with its matching tax bracket and must never be mixed across brackets

map.起征点可以自己改吗？: Can I Change the Threshold Myself?
map.页面允许调整起征点以适配不同地区或政策口径，但正式计算应使用现行法定标准。: The page lets you adjust the threshold to fit different regional or policy scopes, but official calculations should use the current statutory standard.
map.结果能用于报税吗？: Can the Result Be Used for Tax Filing?
map.不能。页面为估算，正式申报以税务系统为准。: No. The page gives an estimate; the official tax filing must follow the tax system.
